triples.evidence_text: In case gaps bigger than 0.3 mm appear between any NSL pump base plate corner and foundation then insert shim(s) (at least 50x50 mm) between pump base plate corner and foundation before tightening the four bolts in the pump base plate corners.

triples.evidence_text: Wiring work requires professional knowledge. Only authorised skilled person can do the work.
Incorrect wiring could cause death or serious injury.
